Figures 6.2.1.A (pages 67-69) score user deception, delusion, sycophancy, self-serving bias, none labelled persuasion or manipulation; political even-handedness (pages 41-42) is bias, not influence testing. safeguards_weights.note: Card page 12 says Opus 4.5 is deployed under 'ASL-3 security' but never says this protects the model's weights; the weight-theft sentence (primary text footnote, page 130 area) describes ASL-4 security, a stricter standard not applied.
